entries.zh: 相会；结伴、合伙（互相约定而成伙）
entries.en: to agree together; to form a partnership/company

entries.zh: 大家思量；众人共同商议、合计
entries.en: for all to consider together; to deliberate in common
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（Concertarse u [残]），且两处调号 T99 污损；释义依汉字与 R 栏对音。

entries.zh: 起价；议定价钱、开价
entries.en: to set/fix the price, to name a price

entries.zh: 套谋；串通设谋（同谋做坏事）
entries.en: to conspire, to plot together for ill
entries.notes: M 栏另有『tó giǒg』异读且首调 T99 污损；R 栏 tem men 与 tō bōu 对应，释义取汉字『套谋』。

entries.zh: 思量；商量、合计
entries.en: to think over, to deliberate

entries.zh: 套局；设局、串通害人
entries.en: to conspire to do harm; to lay a trap together

entries.zh: 通同；串通一气、相互勾结
entries.en: to act in collusion, to agree secretly together
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（Concertarse de sege en [残]）；释义依汉字『通同』及 R 栏对音。

entries.zh: 涂抹；抹去、涂销（原件疑与『议价成交』义不符，存疑）
entries.en: to smear over, to erase; 〔sense uncertain: given as agreement of parties on price〕
entries.notes: 汉字『涂抹』与西语『各方议定价钱』明显不合，四栏互证不清，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 私评〔疑〕；私下串谋反抗尊上（汉字疑为『私盟/私评』之误写）
entries.en: to conspire privately against a superior
entries.notes: M 栏仅记一调、汉字『私評』与西语『串通反抗尊长』对应不密，取西语义为主并标存疑。

entries.zh: 谋害；共谋加害、合谋行叛
entries.en: to plot together to commit treachery/harm

entries.zh: 相通同；串通一气以行欺诈
entries.en: to collude together in order to deceive

entries.zh: 处常〔疑〕；约定而成、出自素常之性（西语 instinto：本性、天生的惯常）
entries.en: settled by habit/nature; innate disposition
entries.notes: 汉字『處常』与西语 Concertado, instinto 对应依赖推断（处其常＝惯常而定），取『素常惯定』义。

entries.zh: 齐入〔疑〕；齐整周备、谨慎检点（西语 circumspecto：谨慎）
entries.en: orderly and circumspect; careful in conduct
entries.notes: 汉字『齊入』与 circumspecto 的对应依赖推断；依西语 17 世纪义给『齐整谨慎』。

entries.zh: 朴实；质朴有德（西语 virtuoso：有德行的）
entries.en: simple and honest; virtuous

entries.zh: 斡旋；为一件器物（chabacan，陶罐/瓮）说合居中调停成交
entries.en: to mediate/negotiate the sale of a jar (chabacan)
entries.notes: 汉字栏原注疑（斡旋/軋旋）；chabacan 为马尼拉语境陶罐（他加禄 chabacano/tabaco 罐类），居中说合义取『斡旋』。

entries.zh: 华靡；华丽悦目（西语 Concertado, hermoso：打扮齐整好看）
entries.en: splendid, handsome; gaudily adorned

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（Concha：贝壳；g. infra.＝见下文）
entries.en: shell (concha); see below (g. infra.); 〔manuscript columns blank〕
entries.notes: 汉、闽、官三栏皆 [空]，仅有西语词头及『见下』指涉，无法释义。

entries.zh: 交关了；交易说定、买卖成交（fijo：已定之约）
entries.en: the bargain is concluded; a settled deal

entries.zh: 交结明白；交易结清、账目分明（诸约皆定）
entries.en: transactions settled and clearly accounted; bargains all fixed
entries.notes: M 栏一处 T99 污损（结字调号）；释义依汉字『交結明白』。

entries.zh: 交结；订立交易、结成买卖之约
entries.en: to conclude a bargain, to settle a deal

entries.zh: 揽定；包揽议定、承揽成约
entries.en: to take on and fix by agreement; contracts secured
entries.notes: M 栏 mān tià 与汉字『攬定』对应，R 栏 mon teng 音差较大，取汉字义。

entries.zh: 死结；解不开的死约〔疑：西语 rebocable（可撤销）与『死结』义相左〕
entries.en: a fast/irrevocable knot (dead knot); 〔contradicts Sp. rebocable, revocable〕
entries.notes: 汉字『死結』＝不可解之结，与西语 Concertos rebocable（可撤销之约）正相反，疑西语栏脱否定词（no rebocable），四栏互证不清。
